d: Gaara and Naruto corner Hoko, the last of the Four Celestials, in a gully. They find out that their goal is to steal the Sand Spirit Shukaku's chakra in order to gain the power to challenge the Five Great Nations.
Gaara transforms into Shukaku the Sand Spirit but uses his own power to suppress Shukaku and manage an impressive win. Naruto leaves on a training journey with Jiraiya, who has finally returned.

st: Rock Lee is a Ninja Who Can't Use Ninjutsu / Rock Lee's Rival is Naruto
d: One day, Rock Lee, the hardest working ninja in the village, rescues a young girl. Later, Rock Lee is on a mission to get a special cake from a bakery where only limited quantities are made daily. Suddenly, Naruto appears with the same goal.

st: Love is a Part of the Springtime of Youth / Love Makes Both Sides Crazy
d: Rock Lee has a crush on Sakura Haruno. He mounts numerous "love offenses" his target, but Sakura manages to easily brush them off.

st: A Competition with the Genius Ninja, Neji / Tenten's Must-Win Battle!
d: Lee's teammate Neji Hyuga is a talented ninja referred to by many as a genius. He is so talented that he took out an enemy boss from the Hidden Grass Village in one strike!

st: Guy Sensei Didn't Do It / Guy Sensei's Rival is Kakashi Sensei!
d: Lee's beloved Guy Sensei is arrested for lewd behavior! Lee promises to clear his master's name. Later, Kakashi Sensei's secret move defeats Guy, and Lee decides to follow Kakashi and become as powerful as he is.

st: I'm Going to Teach Konohamaru Kempo / I Save My Lucky Undies for Physicals
d: Konohamaru usually practices ninjutsu with Naruto. But now he's sought out Rock Lee to learn better hand-to-hand combat skills. Later, Lee and the others are ordered to undergo a routine physical exam.

st: The Leaf Village Sports Meet / Chicken Battles are part of the Thrill of Youth.
d: The Hidden Leaf Village is holding a sports meet! Lee is called to read the Athlete's Pledge of Fair Play, but screws up in front of the entire stadium.

st: Orochimaru is a Type-B Scorpio / Love Letters are the Ultimate Trap
d: Lee and his team are on guard duty at the front gate, but they'll have to be extra vigilant. Later, Lee is flummoxed by Guy-sensei's new "Smooth Operator Fist."

st: Even Hokage Go Bald / Orochimaru is Persistent
d: Lee's team is pulling bodyguard duty for the Fifth Hokage Tsunade while she's off on a gambling binge. Later, Orochimaru summons Manda to swallow Tsunade, Naruto, and even Guy-sensei whole!

st: Hinata is Neji's Cousin / Hinata's Weakness is Naruto
d: Neji's cousin Hinata is trying to get some training in, but it's not easy with Lee constantly getting in the way. Later, Lee and several others don a familiar orange outfit.

st: Teamwork Symbolizes Youth / The Culprit is Among Us
d: After seeing Shikamaru and Choji in action, Lee attempts to strengthen his friendship with Neji. Later, the Leaf ninja are scheduled to take an IQ test, but on the way to the exam, Lee's team discovers Guy Sensei collapsed on the ground!

st: A Field Trip to the Old Capital! / Girls' Rooms and Candy Boxes!
d: Lee and Naruto are both vying to be on Sakura's team for a research trip to the old capital city. Later, evening falls and Lee wants to slip away from all the Sensei to go hang out with the girls.

st: The No-Ninjutsu Lifestyle / I want to Share an Umbrella with Sakura
d: Fed up with their pupils using their ninja skills for the simplest tasks, Guy and Kakashi set out to teach them a lesson. Later, Lee is training in the rain without an umbrella, when he sees Sakura getting soaked as well.
